I couldn't find a deadline for the Tamsin Cold Chain signed order form in anything Marcus can see, and I told him that in a reply to his message in #north-team.

**Where I looked:** the four channels he's in (#north-team, #north-random, #general and #inc-qfl-sev1), the North team digests and cheat sheet, and the public files. No Tamsin account files were visible to me (no contracts, tickets or CRM notes). I didn't use message search because its results include conversations Marcus can't see.

**What turned up on Tamsin:** only support items. Those were a timeout on the refrigerated-trailer temperature check at the Tacoma yard, a stalled report export, and notes separating frozen from chilled arrivals. None of them mention an order form date.

The digests list Tamsin as Dana Okafor's account, so I pointed Marcus to Dana or June Osei-Lark on the deal desk. I also suggested he leave the date out of the tracker until one of them confirms it.
